messages:
ashley: Quick async check — pulling together a tiny checklist for this week's dedicated buildout. Key asks: procurement ETA for the last 8 A100s, which racks have completed PDU sequencing, who owns the overnight burn-in window, and did we lock the 2 canary reservation slots for Thu-Fri? Trying to avoid surprises ahead of the client demo. :calendar:

devon: Procurement update — vendor confirmed ship date moved to Tue EOD (tracking says delayed by 24h). ETA customs+datacenter arrival Wed night. I filed a shipment exception ticket  #2345-ship.

maria: On PDUs — rack 7/8 have verified sequencing and ATS. Rack 9 still shows missing ground on PDU-2, infra-ops is coordinating with onsite electrician. ETA for fix is 6 hours.

kai: Canary slots: I reserved two slots in the capacity slate (slot IDs: canary-17, canary-18) for Thu 00:00–06:00 and Fri 02:00–08:00. Leaving a 2hr buffer between canaries and prod cutover. Can drop one if we need to extend burn-in.

jeff: Who's owning burn-in overnight ops? I can cover Thu night but will need someone for Fri. Suggest pairing SRE + Platform for first night.

ashley: jeff can cover Thu yes — @maria can you take the Fri overnight? If not, @devon you okay?

maria: I can take Fri night but will need on-call handoff doc updated. Added short checklist to the runbook.

devon: I can be backup for Fri. Also pinged firmware team about BIOS image alignment; they said they pushed v2.1.3 to USB image but we should verify one node before mass burn-in.

kai: Small QA step: can someone run this once post-install?
```bash
ssh root@rack9-node01 'dmesg | grep -i nvlink || true'
```
That verifies NVLink lanes are up — run after BIOS update.

jeff: will run that after provisioning. Also planning a smoke that hits model-serving path: start container, load model weights (~8GB), and do 20 concurrent gen requests. Will post results.

ops-bot: deploy-ticket #ded-2026 created, canary reservations applied, burn-in schedule updated in calendar. :white_check_mark:

ashley: Two quick dependency flags: (1) if customs hold is >24h we need to push canary to next week — devon pls advise if tracking changes; (2) if rack 9 PDU fix slips past 6h we should move one canary to rack 7 as fallback.

devon: noted. I'll update thread if transit status changes. Also chasing a customs contact to try to expedite.

maria: runbook link added here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-burnin (added sections: BIOS verify, NVLink check, smoke test steps, rollback notes). :link:

jeff: quick PR ping — I left a tiny change in infra/playbooks/canary.yml to widen timeouts during burn-in. @ashley can you review? small, 2-line change.

ashley: on it, will review in next 30m. If I don't respond, merge with devon or jeff approval to keep schedule.

sre-bot: reminder: Pager for dedicated-gpu on Thu 23:45–Fri 07:00 has been assigned to jeff (primary) and devon (secondary).

kai: one last note — telemetry pipeline needs a +2 retention for initial burnin traces. I opened a small ticket so we don't lose early regressions.

ashley: perfect. thanks everyone. I'll consolidate into the daily status doc and ping product + sales about possible demo contingency. :thumbsup:
